halt_guidance.blocker: SPLiT-seq requires experiment-specific round-barcode lists, well/sample ranges, and barcode-read orientation before cDNA reads can be assigned to cells.
required_inputs: Barcode sequences for each split-pool round and their read coordinates
Well-to-sample ranges/manifest and the matching reference
next_steps: Recover the round-barcode lists and well/sample assignments from the study supplements or authors.
Confirm which FASTQ carries cDNA and which carries the concatenated barcode/UMI structure.
Run a study-matched SPLiT-seq parser, then align the parsed cDNA and generate a cell-by-gene matrix.

recommended_workflows.name: SPLiT-seq pipeline
recommended_workflows.role: Round-barcode parsing, alignment, and DGE generation

halt_guidance.resume: After experiment-specific barcode parsing, use the resulting matrix or a separately validated STAR workflow; UniScFlow does not invent the missing well map.
